title: Spectral duality structures and the Fisher--Rao geometry of reset distributions
summary: We study the geometry that spectral duality induces on the simplex of reset distributions for absorbed Markov processes with geometric resetting. In the Fisher--Rao metric, selected by Čencov's theorem, the separatrix $Σ$ of reset-neutral distributions is rigid: under the square-root embedding $π\mapsto2\sqrtπ$ its interior is a totally geodesic subsphere of the positive octant, itself a lower-dimensional Fisher--Rao simplex.
